craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of ordained state; vyabhicāri utsāha at three ordaining. Sanskrit-first: tisraḥ (THREE-FEMININE per UNC — kept feminine; powers are she); vidhā (ORDAIN — kept; ordaining by order/opening). Rows: 9 (order/opening pair — ordaining's two instruments), 1 (‘fear gone may I be’ closes — prayer last). Close: ‘by them, devoted-hearted, fear gone may I be’. Rupture: semicolon (obtained stated, then ordaining — six-wheeled stationed, then world-ordered). Rejected: neuter three — killed: feminine kept; ‘decree’ for ordain — killed: ordain ordains (vidhi kept). Read aloud: SO-your-THREE — BY-own-pow-er's-SPREAD ob-TAINED, SIX-wheeled, STA-tioned — … BY-them, de-VOT-ed-HEART-ed, FEAR-gone MAY-i-BE.

lines: So Your three — by own power's spread obtained, six-wheeled, stationed —
they ordain by order, by opening, the varied world-state; by them, devoted-hearted, fear gone may I be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: taditthaṃ te tisro nijavibhavavisphāraṇavaśād | kramād unmeṣeṇa pravidadhati citrāṃ bhavadaśām
